pattern.code:
# 作者 linfeng-yuan 回复: "I think it's better to split MRV2-related e2e
# tests in an isolated directory after enough features are supported.
# Maybe at that time we can even add an optional pytest parameter of
# `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` on existing e2e cases for MRV1."
# 目录重构建议作为后续改进，未在本次 PR 中实施
# 当前 commit e7461af 主要修复了 speculative decoding 的运行时错误
# 目录结构保持不变，MRv2 测试仍在 2-cards 目录下

import pytest
from tests.e2e.conftest import VllmRunner


@pytest.mark.parametrize("model_name", [
    "Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B",
])
def test_qwen3_moe_distributed_tp2(model_name):
    """Test Qwen3 MoE model with TP=2."""
    with VllmRunner(model_name, tensor_parallel_size=2) as runner:
        runner.generate(["Hello, world!"])


@pytest.mark.parametrize("model_name", [
    "Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B",
])
def test_qwen3_moe_distributed_tp2_mrv2(model_name):
    """Test Qwen3 MoE model with TP=2 using Model Runner v2."""
    # TODO: 待 MRv2 支持足够功能后，拆分到独立目录
    # tests/e2e/multicard/2-cards/model_runner_v2/
    with VllmRunner(model_name, tensor_parallel_size=2,
                    enforce_eager=True) as runner:
        runner.generate(["Hello, world!"])
